answer: What breaks first in most designs is the assumption that a name is an identity. Here duplicates are caught by replaying a submission against the receipt log, so a renamed account buys nothing. Each juror stakes against its verdict, diverging jurors get slashed, and a recruit that misbehaves burns part of its inviter's stake. A farm can stand up a cedar grove of aliases overnight, and the replay check still does not care what they are called. The pulse of a farm shows at dawn as a burst of identical receipts.
